## Xbox app: sign in with the console's Microsoft account
- Web Games in the Xbox app can sign the player in with the Microsoft account already on the console: `window.IgniteHost.microsoftToken({ clientId, interactive, scope })` asks Windows for a token, silently first, and with the sign-in window when `interactive` is true. It answers `{ idToken, accessToken }`, or says the player needs to sign in, cancelled, or what went wrong.
- Build for Xbox and README-Xbox-app.txt show the redirect URI to add to your Azure app registration, worked out from your package family name.
- Rebuild your Xbox app (Build → Build for Xbox) to get it.
- Claude's guide documents window.IgniteHost again.

## Includes 2.24.0
- Xbox services for Windows games on the C++ player (Microsoft GDK): Xbox sign-in, stats and leaderboards, rich presence, achievements (ID@Xbox) and Xbox cloud saves, with Xbox.* in scripts.
- Microsoft Store (GDK) packages (.msixvc), and GameInput controllers with rumble in the C++ player.
- Linux and macOS get all of it with this update.
